title: Arches & Aperitivos - Weekly Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup @ Intenso
description: We’re gathering in a beautiful venue tucked beneath elegant Lisbon arches, for a relaxed evening with the Lisbon Digital Nomads community. Expect good drinks, warm conversations, and a setting that feels a little special without being too formal. Come on your own, bring a friend, or drop by and meet someone new. Whether you’ve just arrived in Lisbon or already call it home, you’re very welcome. **Happy Hour! (7:30–8:30 PM)**: Since there’s a large discounted selection, I’ve uploaded the full happy hour menu [here.](https://imgur.com/a/xWavUDl) It will be applicable for 7:30pm to 8:30pm 😁 See you there! ***About us:*** We're a group of Nomads, Slowmads, Expats, and Locals who love to meet like-minded people and have a regular meetup running every Thursday since 2017! And the Nomad community is buzzing in Lisbon! Check out our socials to see photos and get updates: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lisbondigitalnomads/) join our [Slack community](https://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack) to connect with others! We're all volunteers, these events are not for profit, and we try to find the most awesome ways to connect you on a personal and a professional level. ***Join our team:*** We're currently looking for talented community hosts to join our team. If you think you're up for the challenge of hosting our Thursday meetups and giving back to the community - [please apply to become a host](https://forms.gle/bD388ScQehorr2CH8). We would love to hear from you! ***Do you have a venue for 100+ people indoors? Partner with us:*** We have some spots available for venues that would like to host our Thursday meetups. Our events bring a huge boost in revenue to you on a Thursday night. Get in touch! [Please fill up our venue partnership form](https://bit.ly/ldn-venue-apply) and we'll be in touch with you. Whether you're a nomad passing through Lisbon, staying for a season, living in Lisbon, or are an aspiring digital nomad, you're all welcome to join our events! **📣 Friendly reminder** Our meetups are all about creating a safe, inclusive, and welcoming space for everyone, even as our community grows. Bring your best vibe, treat others with kindness and respect, and make an effort to greet new faces. Remember, everyone has the right to their boundaries—whether it’s a hug, a dance, a drink, or a conversation. Let’s ensure our community thrives by treating each other as we’d like to be treated. Looking forward to meeting you! ***The Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup Team*** PS - Join our Slack community [here](http://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack). PPS - Follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lisbondigitalnomads) to see photos and get updates.
